# Trendy Pearls Australia — Full Knowledge Base & Product Catalog (trendypearls.au)

## Brand Identity & Overview
Trendy Pearls (https://trendypearls.au) is a premier Australian retailer specializing in South Asian ethnic wear and traditional Indian jewellery. We bring handpicked, high-end fashion and authentic handcrafted ornaments directly to customers across Australia.

## Order & Customer Service Process
1. **Browsing**: Customers view live stock and interactive collections on https://trendypearls.au.
2. **Cart & WhatsApp Checkout**: Orders are seamlessly compiled into a shopping cart and transmitted via instant WhatsApp message to our customer service team.
3. **Delivery**: Orders are processed with fast dispatch to Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, and across regional Australia.
4. **Digital Receipts**: Instant generated digital receipt (https://trendypearls.au/receipt.html) with full itemized breakdown.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Does Trendy Pearls deliver across all of Australia?
A: Yes, Trendy Pearls ships nationwide across Australia, including metro and regional areas.

### Q: How do I order items from Trendy Pearls?
A: You can add items to your cart directly on https://trendypearls.au and click "Order via WhatsApp" to complete your purchase directly with our team.

### Q: Are the jewellery pieces adjustable?
A: Yes, our choker sets and necklaces feature comfortable adjustable thread/dori closures suitable for all sizes.

### Q: What fabrics are used for the clothing collection?
A: We use high-quality fabrics including Organza, Mul Chanderi, Pure Cotton, Georgette, and Silk blends for maximum comfort and durability.
